title: StageIdentity
description: Everything a stage's output depends on.

implementation.description:
The implementation that computes it: Splinter's version plus any
worker or trainer digest the stage runs.

inputs.description: The digests of the products the stage consumes, by role.

name.description: The stage's name in its recipe (`local`, `sft`, `lora-r16`).

parameters.description:
The resolved parameters, after defaults and file contents (as their
digests) are substituted.

seed.description: The explicit seed, when the stage draws randomness.

Digest.description: A content address: blake3 or sha256, 64 lowercase hex digits.

StageKind.description: The kinds of stage a recipe is planned into.

oneOf.description: Load and pin the task collection.
One rollout pass: agents attempt tasks.
Project trials into a training dataset.
